record.question: The first woman to become a Chief Minister of any state in India was?
record.explanation: Answer C: Sucheta Kripalani. She became Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh in1963, the first woman to hold a state chief ministership in India. Reference: https://www.upvidhansabhaproceedings.gov.in/laleaders-of-the-house. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: PART-A (150 Marks). All questions carry equal marks of 2 each. Attempt all questions. This Section should be answered only on the OMR Response Sheet provided.
